Engineer auto-turret integration
================================

Turret sprites and sounds were supplied by the project owner from the
"Aliens Eradication Auto Turret extraction" archive, sourced from
ALIENS_ERADICATION_TC_2_0.pk3.

The moving tracer.md3 and tracer1.tga assets were supplied from the project
owner's Doomtopmode project. TuinRPG uses a new ZScript deployment, targeting,
combat, ownership, HUD, and progression implementation.
